tagline: Build it. Prove it. Ship it.
positioning: Proof over promises. Local-first software with receipts, honest claims, and user-owned workflows.

products.name: Reality Gate
products.summary: Local-first developer continuity for the Git workflow you already use. Keep GitHub, GitLab, or Forgejo — Reality Gate maps dependencies, verifies continuity, and keeps signed receipts of what was checked.
products.build: Windows installer EXE delivered inside a ZIP archive. The published SHA-256 is the checksum of the ZIP you download; the installer EXE inside carries its own checksum in the build's BUILD-INFO.
products.releaseNote: Developer Pilot v1.1.0 (Windows). Suite composition: Static 269/269 · Live registry 24/24 · Installed runtime 20/20 (269/269 canonical). Pre-pilot audit: PILOT READY, no blockers, no overstated claims; two non-blocking notes (BUG-001 port discrepancy, BUG-002 IPv4 loopback binding) affect standalone server execution only, not the packaged app. Windows SmartScreen may prompt on first launch — verify the ZIP SHA-256 first.

products.name: Cache Vault
products.summary: Local-first clipboard vault with stamped receipts, safes, global search, Quick Paste, image capture, exports, and proof-pack workflows.
products.releaseNote: The latest public release is v0.1.9 (873 tests). The v0.1.4 artifact is the most recent with a committed ZIP and checksum in the repo. The next external-test build (v0.2.0/v0.2.1, repaired Windows/Android pair) is still in draft reliability validation.

products.name: Lights Out PC
products.summary: Local-first night control for Windows. Plan tonight's session on your PC, control it from bed with the Android Companion, and wake with First Light. Compatible smart lights, schedule automation, an experimental Wi-Fi Guard, and proof of every run.
products.releaseNote: The current internal build is Electron v11.1.2 (Desktop) with Android Companion v11.1.1; 313/313 tests pass. In-app Smart Lights setup covers Philips Hue and generic HTTP webhooks, and Wi-Fi Guard (labelled Experimental in-app) integrates with TP-Link, ASUS, Netgear, custom webhook, and local Wi-Fi-adapter paths. No public artifact has been released yet — the download appears once account-safe distribution is ready.

products.name: Cleanroom
products.summary: Archive-first Windows cleanup with receipts, custody checks, and rollback. No cloud, no account, no telemetry.
products.build: CI-built Windows installer (PyInstaller + Inno Setup). Provenance attested via GitHub Actions.
products.releaseNote: Public release v1.0.7 (the last with a published artifact). Source has advanced to v1.0.10; no newer verified public release has been established yet.

products.name: ForgeCast Weather
products.summary: Day-planning weather: what to wear, when to go outside, what to bring or skip, and why. Decision-first Today screen, verified with 724 tests.
products.releaseNote: Frozen historical release v0.3.3. Do not rebuild or replace this artifact. v0.3.4 is tagged in source but its APK was never published to R2 and its test suite has regressions — it is not a public release. Future APK publication is pending secure successor signing/identity work.

products.name: ProofShot
products.summary: Local-first Windows proof workstation: capture what matters online, keep a proof bundle with SHA-256 receipts and a Proof Passport, and verify it later without trusting the tool or the internet. Rebrand in progress — the engine currently ships as HyperSnatch v1.6.18 under its legacy name.
products.build: Electron desktop application: SmartDecode v2.5.0 extraction pipeline, proof-bundle export (SHA-256 manifests, Proof Passport, offline HTML verifier), 99/99 E2E green. Rebrand in progress — the engine ships as HyperSnatch v1.6.18 under the original brand while ProofShot identity work continues.
products.releaseNote: The underlying engine (HyperSnatch v1.6.18) is public under its legacy name, with a 99/99 E2E test suite, SHA-256 checksums, and release receipts. The ProofShot rebrand has not yet propagated through packaging and code, so no release or download is claimed under the ProofShot name. ProofForge is a separate project and is not this product.
